mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.code, m.name, m.display_name, m.icon, m.path, m.component, m.permission_name, m.parent_id, m.sort_order, m.is_enabled, m.is_hidden, m.is_external, m.external_url, m.menu_type, m.tenant_id, m.is_deleted FROM whale_user_roles ur INNER JOIN whale_roles r ON ur.role_id = r.id AND r.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN whale_permission_grants pg ON pg.provider_key = r.id AND pg.provider_name = 'R' AND pg.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN whale_permissions p ON pg.permission_name = p.name AND p.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN whale_menus m ON m.permission_name = p.name AND m.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.is_deleted = 0 AND m.is_enabled = 1 AND m.is_hidden = 0 ORDER BY m.sort_order, m.id
